title: Memoize Cache Decorator

visible.label: Caches positional arguments and avoids recomputation
visible.inputDisplay: @memoize fib or counter called twice on same args
visible.expectedDisplay: Underlying function executes once per unique input
visible.script:
calls = 0
@memoize
def square(x):
    global calls
    calls += 1
    return x * x
assert square(5) == 25
assert square(5) == 25
assert square(6) == 36
assert calls == 2

visible.label: Independent decorated functions maintain separate caches
visible.inputDisplay: Two @memoize functions called with same key (2)

hidden.label: Handles keyword arguments distinctly from positional mismatches
hidden.script:
hits = 0
@memoize
def scale_val(x, factor=1):
    global hits
    hits += 1
    return x * factor
assert scale_val(4, factor=2) == 8
assert scale_val(4, factor=2) == 8
assert scale_val(4, factor=3) == 12
assert hits == 2

hidden.label: Caches False and None return values properly
hidden.inputDisplay: Returning None/False should still hit cache
hidden.script:
cnt = 0
@memoize
def maybe(x):
    global cnt
    cnt += 1
    return None if x == 0 else False
assert maybe(0) is None
assert maybe(0) is None
assert maybe(1) is False
assert maybe(1) is False
assert cnt == 2

hidden.label: Preserves function name with functools.wraps
Multiple arguments cached tuple key
hidden.script:
n = 0
@memoize
def add(a, b):
    global n
    n += 1
    return a + b
assert add(3, 4) == 7 and add(3, 4) == 7
assert n == 1

hints: Create a fresh dict `cache = {}` INSIDE `memoize(fn)` so each decorated function keeps its own isolated dictionary.
Key by `(args, tuple(sorted(kwargs.items())))` and check `if key not in cache: cache[key] = fn(*args, **kwargs)` (do NOT check `cache.get(key) is None` when None itself can be a valid return value!).
